label.en: 01131 : 01 Food and nonalcoholic beverages  - 1 Food  - 3 Fish  - 1 Fresh, chilled or frozen fish

description.en: VAT rate for COICOP category 01131 — Fresh, chilled or frozen fish (01 Food and nonalcoholic beverages > 1 Food > 3 Fish > 1 Fresh, chilled or frozen fish). The Consumption-Tax add-on (CT_XBASE) reads this parameter through its LIST_ct income-list (RegExp_Def '$tco_t_[0-9]+', 'vat rates') to build consumer prices and the implicit consumption-tax rate applied to household expenditure in this COICOP category (excise goods are handled in a second price step); the matching $tco_base_* value supplies the no-reform baseline used to isolate the tax effect.
